review_notes.rounds: Three rounds. Round 1 blocked a false diagnosis: any path error was reported as a missing ref, so a permission failure claimed the ref did not exist. Round 2 confirmed that fix and found the next layer: a ref resolving to a directory fell through to a raw wrap that leaked the absolute path and refs/heads/. Round 3 APPROVE.
review_notes.structural_note: after the ref prefix matches, all four returns build a fresh error from the user's ref string alone and never re-wrap the original cause, so no future cause can leak through this path
review_notes.declined_by_design: a dedicated exit code for budget refusal and printing the model's summary field were both left undone because they would break AUR-433's and AUR-426's delivered contracts; the round-1 reviewer verified both pins line by line and accepted the refusals
